test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the simplified value of cos² (90º - θ) -[ [frac{{cos(90circ-theta)cos theta}}{cot theta}] ]?
solution:
**Given:**

cos2(90º – θ) – (cos(90-theta)costheta)/(cottheta)

**Concept used:**

cos(90 – θ) = sinθ

**Calculations:**

cos2(90º – θ) – (cos(90-theta)costheta)/(cottheta)

⇒ sin²θ – (sintheta costheta)/(cottheta)

⇒ sin²θ – sin²θ

⇒ 0

**∴ The Required simplified value is 0.**
